li.label: afraid of them now
li.description: I know what those hands have done. I keep the table between us, and I always know where the door is.

li.label: fascinated by their past
li.description: Finally, someone interesting around here. I have so many questions for them.

li.label: they put lives at risk
li.description: They knew what they were carrying and got on that ship anyway, and people died of it. I don't trust them.

li.label: a real star
li.description: I know their songs by heart, and all this time they've been mending fences with the rest of us.

li.label: touched by their secret
li.description: I never knew they had that in them. I've been looking at them differently all day.

li.label: wasteful
li.description: Out here every scrap and every patch of good soil is earned, and they've been spending ours on nothing.

li.label: took credit that wasn't theirs
li.description: All those compliments at dinner, and not once did they say who really made it.

li.label: heard their story
li.description: They told us all of it, the worst parts too, and answered every question put to them.

li.label: an old wound opened
li.description: I'd almost stopped thinking about it. Now they all know, they're all kind about it, and it's all I think about.

li.label: they'll come for me now
li.description: The people who want me found know where to look now. I sit with my back to the wall.

li.label: no more pretending
li.description: They know I'm sick now. I don't have to smile through the bad days anymore.

li.label: watched like a criminal
li.description: One of them is always in the next field or the next room, watching me. I've stopped talking much.

li.label: the colony heard me out
li.description: I told them all of it and answered every question. They stayed to the end.

li.label: my story went badly
li.description: I told them my side, and it went wrong halfway through. I gave the rest in as few words as I could and left early.

li.label: the council sold me out
li.description: They took silver for telling the hunters where I sleep. I sleep with a knife now, and I don't sleep much.

li.label: the council protected me
li.description: The hunters wanted me, and the council made sure they didn't get me. I'll owe them for that as long as I live.

li.label: blood money in the stores
li.description: We sold one of our own for a sack of silver. I can't look at the stockpile the same way.

li.label: turned down good silver
li.description: Hunters offered us a sack of silver to look the other way, just once, and the council said no.

li.label: doctoring under supervision
li.description: Someone checks every stitch I make now. I suppose I've earned it, but it stings.

li.label: barred from doctoring
li.description: They took my instruments away. Maybe they're right to. I was good at this once.

li.label: told to hold my tongue
li.description: I only said what the rest of them were thinking, and the council told me to hold my tongue.

li.label: the colony paid my debt
li.description: Years of looking over my shoulder, settled with silver that wasn't mine. I'll find a way to pay them back.

li.label: left alone with my debt
li.description: They know who I owe and what those people do. They said it's my problem. I suppose it is.

li.label: honored at supper
li.description: They raised their cups to me at supper. I didn't know where to look, but I'm still smiling about it.

li.label: a quiet thank-you
li.description: A few quiet words of thanks from the council, in private. That suited me fine.

li.label: someone else's toast
li.description: They all raised their cups to one person for a few kind deeds. I do kind things too, and no one toasts me.

li.label: quarantined
li.description: I'm shut in a room by myself, with food left at the door. The people I care about talk to me through it.

li.label: the council took precautions
li.description: There was a danger right here among us, and the council dealt with it. I'll sleep better.

li.label: made to fight for a crowd again
li.description: I left the fighting pits behind, and now I'm fighting for a crowd again, with bets on me.

li.label: kept out of the pit
li.description: They wanted me to fight for a show, and the council said no. I'm not that person anymore, and the council believes it.

li.label: getting clean, with help
li.description: A few days off work and a friend beside me. I might actually stay clean this time.

li.label: saw them through the worst
li.description: I sat up with them through some long, bad nights. They're still clean this morning.

li.label: my room was searched
li.description: They went through everything I own and burned what they found. Now I have to get through this alone.

li.label: they let it lie
li.description: The others were told to drop it, and they mostly have. I can eat my dinner in peace again.

li.label: not allowed to talk about it
li.description: We're not to talk about it, by order of the council. Now it's all I can think about.

li.label: my secret, my say
li.description: The council let me decide what happens with it now. After everything, that's more than I expected.
